Aurora 2 officially launches with 500,000 token context

Vendor has released Aurora 2, confirming a 500,000 token context window and pricing of $3 per million input tokens.

The company says the model is available today for paid API accounts in the United States and European Union.

Aurora 2 reportedly scored 74.5% on SWE-bench Verified in Vendor's internal testing, a figure the company has not had independently confirmed.
